(1) A voice note at 07:37, «بدي كرتونة مي تنورين وقهوة نجار على بعقلين، وكمان بدي نص كفة» (Kapso's transcript, outside opening hours): the reading's third line «نص كفة» (half a kilo of kafta; the transcript writes kafta «كفة») was not found (a demand row, unknown_product) and the reply, a location request written by the model, said nothing of it. Nothing the customer asks for is dropped in silence: it goes on the card or the reply names it. «كفة» is kafta's word now (0256), and any line still not found is named by code (pipeline.ts lostText, nameLost). (2) A voice note at 08:39 with «cafe mate» (Coffee-mate creamer, AK-0132, which we carry): the planner found «cafe» in three Najjar coffees, «mate» in none, and code asked «which one?» over the Najjar coffees. 'cafe mate' is Coffee Mate's words now (0256), and a «which one?» never offers products when a word the customer said, which none of them explains, names another product's brand or kind ("nescafe vanilla" over vanilla items): that line is a kind we cannot show and gets PD1's honest answer (0256, b4 'other_kind'). Run by test/db/cx2-founder-chat.test.ts; the readings are scripted as the live model gave them on staging.
